@RationalTickets.uniform_ticket_expectation
     : forall (A : Type) (mu : Representation.SubEnumQ A) (f : option A -> rat.rat),
       @RationalTickets.ticket_expectation A mu f =
       @ssralg.GRing.add
         (ssrnum.Num.NumDomain.Exports.Num_NumDomain__to__GRing_Nmodule
            rat.rat_rat__canonical__Num_NumDomain)
         (@FiniteEnum.finite_expect rat.rat_rat__canonical__Num_NumDomain A
            (fun x : A => f (@Some A x)) (@Representation.subenumQ_data A mu))
         (@ssralg.GRing.mul
            (ssralg.GRing.Ring.Exports.GRing_Ring__to__GRing_SemiRing
               rat.rat_rat__canonical__GRing_Ring)
            (@ssralg.GRing.add
               (ssralg.GRing.SemiRing.Exports.GRing_SemiRing__to__GRing_Nmodule
                  (ssralg.GRing.Ring.Exports.GRing_Ring__to__GRing_SemiRing
                     rat.rat_rat__canonical__GRing_Ring))
               (ssralg.GRing.one
                  (ssralg.GRing.Ring.Exports.GRing_Ring__to__GRing_SemiRing
                     rat.rat_rat__canonical__GRing_Ring))
               (@ssralg.GRing.opp rat.rat_rat__canonical__GRing_Zmodule
                  (@Representation.enumQ_mass A (@Representation.subenumQ_raw A mu))))
            (f (@None A)))
